module: Flowgraph node "Set Gravity" (category dynamic_instant). Sets the global gravity (value pin, in m/s², 0 by default) via core_environment.setGravity. The original gravity is stored when the graph starts and restored on stop (data.restoreGravity).

_executionStopped.desc: Restores the stored gravity if data.restoreGravity is true.

workOnce.desc: Applies the gravity of the value pin once.

work.desc: In repeat mode, reapplies the gravity every frame only if the value pin is used (connected).
